reasoning: The icon is a horizontal battery alert symbol where the right end and terminal nub are replaced by an exclamation mark. While useful for tasks about charging, replacing, or troubleshooting dying batteries, omitting the positive terminal makes the shape look ambiguously like a C-bracket or magnet next to an exclamation point.
